usecase.name: [QA Validation App] UJ-18 Execution Variable Badges
usecase.description: A run's Execution Steps table shows every {{name}} in instructions and validation values as a VAR badge: a defined variable shows its value, {{UniqueID}} the placeholder UNIQUE_ID, an undefined token UNDEFINED_VALUE, a retrieve_value capture its value once captured; the first column header is '#', there is no Validation column and a grey validation box (Type / Operator, Expected, Actual) sits under the instruction and the retrieve_value step shows a capture box (Variable / Type, Value); the snapshot is listed under Defined Variables; then the use case is deleted
